summary: Defines the SDP media-level attribute "rtcp-mux-only", which an endpoint uses to signal that it supports only RTP and RTCP multiplexing on a single port. It also updates RFC 5761 by clarifying how an offerer can indicate this. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Some programs only know how to share one road for two kinds of traffic. This document adds a short sign that says "I only use the shared road" so the other side does not offer two.

questions: how to indicate exclusive rtcp multiplexing in sdp
